report.explanation: Current telemetry does not substantiate the operator's faulty-deployment hypothesis. Traces show all sampled checkout flows returning 200 with healthy inventory, payment, and postgres spans. Metrics show order v1.0.0 serving /v1/orders 200s with zero 502s; v2.0.0 shows no traffic. The only deployment record is baseline v1.0.0 with no previous version, so no faulty rollout is evidenced. No bounded cause is established; hand off.
missing_evidence: Error logs or traces showing actual checkout failures (order logs were excluded from context)
Deployment record of a new order version rollout with a previous version to compare
Metric series showing nonzero error statuses (e.g., 5xx) on checkout or order routes
Evidence of latency or saturation in a specific dependency (redis, postgres, payment)
